citations.claim: body centre beyond right boundary at first violating step, overshoot 0.389 > 0.15 limit
one step earlier body still inside arena and moving right at full speed, no bounce occurred between
horizontal velocity unchanged across the boundary crossing, showing missed wall impulse

counterfactual.change: Reduced initial vx from 38.89 to 10.0 only; slower body bounces/stays inside for same 22 steps, so failure is speed-dependent missed boundary collision.

explanation: Fast body (vx~38.9, dt~0.0157 => ~0.61 units/step) crosses the right boundary between step 21 (x~18.95, inside) and step 22 (x~19.57, overshoot 0.389) with vx unchanged, i.e. no wall impulse applied. Likely cause: boundary collision detection/resolution misses the impact when the per-step displacement carries the centre fully past the wall face, so the body tunnels out instead of bouncing.
vision_note: The red ball moves steadily rightward toward the right boundary through steps 19 to 21. In step 22 it ends up embedded in and protruding past the right wall instead of bouncing inward.
